Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 96: May 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #96 shipped to subscribers in April 2009 (bearing the cover date of May 2009 for Issue 96). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #96 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, unlockable content, and exclusive previews:

UFC 2009 Undisputed (mixed martial arts combat simulation)
Fight Night Round 4 (boxing simulation)
Fuel (open-world off-road racing)
Overlord II (action-adventure strategy)
CellFactor: Psychokinetic Wars (Xbox Live Arcade sci-fi arena FPS)
Texas Hold'em (Xbox Live Arcade card game update)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Modern Warfare 2, Splinter Cell: Conviction, and Dead Rising 2, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
